description: Bailouts on a version 2 trade account (account, or the wallet's own): each live offer with its terms (at_ltv, to_ltv, max_usdg, fee_bps, term, expiry, foreclosure bound) and what a rescue takes now by the account's own lens (needed, and needed if the account's bUSDG cannot be redeemed when it lands; what to approve; what the account's free USDG and bUSDG put in ahead of the rescuer; the position's equity against the claim; past its LLTV or under water; an offer the account's bUSDG helps cover reads takeable; takeable or why not), and the bailout owed if any (the rescuer, the principal, what is owed now with the fee earned so far, maturity, whether the rescuer may foreclose now and within what bound). With wallet, also what the account keeps for that wallet to claim. With neither account nor wallet: the offers a rescuer can take across the newest 50 version 2 accounts, the takeable ones ahead, each with its prepare call (Borro's keeper lists every takeable offer at /jobs.json). A rescue is the rescuer's own USDG lent against the rescued position plus money that arrives in the account while it is owed: if the position is liquidated anyway the rescuer can lose it.

wallet.description: The account's owner (when account is not given), or a wallet whose claims to show
